description: The closed vocabularies for two auth wire fields. A value is added only with the PR of the producer that emits it, together with its own migration; no speculative values (CHAOS-10194). error.v1 and authorization_decision.v1 reason_code stay open per surface and are NOT governed by this file.

audit_reason_code.note: The codes already used by valid fixtures in this corpus (authorization decisions and error.v1), plus the revoked_reason values.
